name: If-Match
description: The quoted strong entity tag of the resource the client last read (its `etag` field or `ETag` response header). The mutation is applied only when it still matches: a stale value returns 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED and a missing header returns 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED. `*` matches any current version of an existing group (RFC 9110), for a deliberate last-writer-wins change.
